title: Defaults That Must Carry (Cold Start Doctrine)
style: doctrine propagation anthem, 95 bpm, ops discipline rap, deadpan rule recital, terminal core, cold-start vibe, sparse drum machine, ledger flow, lane defaults
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Right tool for the job code for SSH and rsync
Cowork for multi source pushes and docs sync
Mixed start where the heavy work is heavy
Hand the other lane the seat steady

[Pre-Chorus]
Architectural is not policy block
State the boundary propose the seat lock

[Chorus]
Defaults that must carry defaults that must carry
Five rules baked cold start no quarry
No menu in steady state shipping line
Operator owns the call agent executes design

[Verse 2]
Same every day deploy is the canonical script
Rsync to VDS three three six no flip
No re-asking host or key or path
The script holds the answer the lane holds the math

[Bridge]
Verify before building yes
But do not menu before deploying the press

[Outro]
Defaults that must carry the doctrine sticks
Every cold start reads the file no tics
